Nida Experiment Card PC130 - 23
Nida Experiment Card PC130 - 25
Nida Experiment Card PC130 - 26
In this lesson, you will determine if a zener diode voltage regulator circuit and a variable voltage regulator circuit is faulted and if so, what the fault is.
INTRODUCTIONM
A multimeter is used to determine if the voltage regulator circuit is operating correctly by comparing calculated and measured Eout.
The output voltage measurement will indicate several probable faults.
Measuring the circuit's voltage drops and component resistances will determine which component is faulted.
Let's begin the lesson on VOLTAGE REGULATOR TROUBLESHOOTING PRACTICE........

ZENER DIODE VOLTAGE REGULATOR
The purpose of this experiment is to give you practice in determining if a zener diode voltage regulator circuit is operating normally and if not, to determine the faulty component.
